title: LatentRL-QAS: Transfer via Latent Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.34634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) emerges as a prominent approach to quantum architecture search (QAS), the automated design of quantum circuits. However, transferring what an agent has learned from one number of qubits to another is still weakly explored: the state, the action space and the neural network of a state-of-the-art RL-QAS agent all grow with the number of qubits, which makes transfer learning across qubit counts prohibitive. We make this transfer possible by introducing LatentRL-QAS, a latent space transfer and refresh framework for RL-based QAS. At its core, a circuit variational autoencoder encodes a circuit as one token per gate and maps circuits on any number of qubits into the same latent space. An RL agent navigates this space instead of adding gates, so its state, actions and network have the same size at every qubit count. translated_title: LatentRL-QAS：基于潜在强化学习的量子架构搜索迁移方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为量子架构搜索（QAS）——即量子电路自动化设计——的一种重要方法。然而，将智能体从一个量子比特数中学到的知识迁移到另一个量子比特数仍缺乏深入研究：最先进的RL-QAS智能体的状态、动作空间和神经网络都会随量子比特数增长，这使得跨量子比特数的迁移学习变得难以实现。我们通过引入LatentRL-QAS使这种迁移成为可能，这是一个面向基于RL的QAS的潜在空间迁移与刷新框架。其核心是一个电路变分自编码器，它将电路编码为每个量子门对应一个token，并将任意量子比特数上的电路映射到同一个潜在空间中。RL智能体在这个空间中进行导航，而不是直接添加量子门，因此其状态、动作和网络在每个量子比特数下都保持相同的大小。潜在空间会定期根据智能体的新发现进行刷新，对于更大的系统……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LatentRL-QAS框架，利用电路变分自编码器将任意量子比特数的电路映射到统一的潜在空间中，使强化学习智能体在固定大小的状态、动作和网络下实现跨量子比特数的迁移学习，并通过对潜在空间的周期性刷新来适应更大系统。
en_tdlr: LatentRL-QAS enables transfer learning across qubit counts in RL-based quantum architecture search by using a circuit variational autoencoder to map circuits of any qubit number into a shared latent space where the RL agent operates, with periodic latent space refreshes to accommodate larger systems.
